contentMap.productCategory: AI Image Generation and AI Video Generation
contentMap.targetAudience: Professionals creating visual content, including creative directors, video producers, art directors, marketing managers, and creative leads

hero.headline: Create High-Quality AI Images & Videos with ByteDance Generative Models
hero.subheadline: Unlock the power of next-generation generative AI with Seedream 4.5 (Image Generation) and Seedance 1.5 Pro (Video Generation) - advanced foundation models developed by ByteDance for high-quality visual content creation.
hero.supportingLine: From text prompts, images, or scripts, generate professional visuals and videos with powerful multimodal AI systems.

productSections.name: Seedream 4.5
productSections.label: Feature 1
productSections.headline: AI Image Generation with Seedream 4.5
productSections.description:
Seedream 4.5 is a high-performance multimodal image generation system designed to produce high-resolution, high-fidelity images from text prompts and visual inputs.
The model unifies text-to-image synthesis, image editing, and multi-image composition within a single framework.

features.title: Advanced Text–Image Alignment
features.description: Accurately translates prompts into visuals with improved semantic understanding.

features.title: High-Resolution Output
features.description: Generate native images up to 1K–4K resolution with strong visual fidelity.

features.title: Superior Typographic Rendering
features.description: Optimized for posters, ads, and text-heavy visual designs.

features.title: Multi-Image Composition with Identity Preservation
features.description: Combines multiple inputs while accurately maintaining subject consistency.

features.title: Strong Structural Fidelity
features.description: Maintains composition, layout, and scene structure with high precision.

productSections.name: Seedance 1.5 Pro
productSections.label: Additional Feature
productSections.headline: AI Video Generation with Seedance 1.5 Pro by Bytedance
productSections.description:
Seedance 1.5 Pro is a next-generation generative model designed for native audio-visual generation, enabling synchronized creation of video and sound together.
Built on a dual-branch diffusion transformer architecture, the model integrates cross-modal learning to produce coherent visual and audio outputs.

features.title: Text-to-Video Generation
features.description: Create videos directly from text prompts.

features.title: Audio-Visual Synchronization
features.description: Generate video and audio simultaneously with strong multimodal alignment.

features.title: Multilingual Lip-Sync
features.description: Supports multilingual and dialect-level lip synchronization.

features.title: Cinematic Camera Control
features.description: Generate videos with dynamic camera movement and cinematic storytelling.

features.title: 10× Faster Inference
features.description: Optimized inference pipeline significantly improves generation speed.

plans.name: Seedream 4.5 (AI Image Generation)
includes: Enhanced typographic rendering for posters, ads & text-heavy designs

plans.name: Seedance 1.5 Pro (AI Video Generation)
includes: Fast inference for quicker video production

referenceMap.heroPattern: Single-screen split hero with brand/logo anchor, strong headline, short supporting copy, and a compact benefit list. Primary emphasis is on immediate conversion through one dominant CTA rather than multiple actions.
referenceMap.sectionRhythm: Linear long-form landing page with a top hero, followed by a lead-capture form block and then sequential feature/product sections. Content is organized in stacked, vertically scrolling modules with clear hierarchy and minimal branching.
referenceMap.cardStyle: Clean utility cards or form panels with rectangular structure, light borders, subtle separation, and content-first layout. Visual styling should stay restrained and enterprise-oriented rather than decorative.
referenceMap.ctaPattern: One primary CTA in the hero, repeated per product section as a focused action. Secondary CTAs are either absent or de-emphasized, supporting a direct-response flow.
referenceMap.pricingPattern: No pricing module is indicated in the reference structure; pricing should be treated as optional and omitted unless business requirements add it.
referenceMap.footerMode: Not present in the provided reference structure; assume a minimal or excluded footer for this pattern map.
referenceMap.mediaPattern: Logo-led hero with minimal media emphasis. Any imagery should function as brand reinforcement or product illustration, not as a dominant narrative panel.
referenceMap.productSectionPattern: Sequential feature sections with a label, headline, short description, and a bullet-like feature list. Each section can stand alone as a product module and should support progressive disclosure of technical capabilities.
referenceMap.formPattern: Prominent lead-generation form block placed near the top of the page, visually separated from the hero. Form styling should be highly utilitarian, with stacked fields, hidden metadata inputs, and strong conversion focus.
referenceMap.animationStyle: Static, low-interaction presentation with no visible motion system in the reference structure.
designNotes: Prioritize clarity, authority, and lead capture over visual storytelling.
Use a restrained enterprise aesthetic with simple layout primitives.
Keep CTAs concentrated and context-specific to reduce decision friction.
Use strong typographic hierarchy to separate hero, form, and product modules.
Prefer stacked content flow over navigational complexity.
If media is added, keep it secondary and informational.

personality.buyer: Creative directors, video producers, art directors, marketing managers, and creative leads
personality.emotion: high-end creative control, technical confidence, and premium multimedia innovation
personality.reasoning: This is an AI visual creation product, so the core category is cinematic AI. However, recent AI pages have already used cinematic-ai, editorial-b2b, and creative-studio, so I am intentionally shifting to a distinct operational-dashboard direction while still honoring the AI category cues through structured visual systems and intelligent motion. The product serves professionals who want precision in image and video output, so the interface should feel like a premium creative workstation: organized, layered, data-aware, and interactive. Since the brand palette is fixed by Techjockey, the page should use the provided orange as the defining identity color, with white, charcoal, and soft grey support. This creates a sharp commercial look that is different from generic purple AI aesthetics and reinforces trust, speed, and enterprise readiness.

typography.heroFontSizeReason: The headline is long and product-specific, so it needs a compact but authoritative size to preserve hierarchy without breaking lines.

colours.colourReason: The brand explicitly provides orange as the primary identity color, so it becomes the hero background and primary CTA color. White and charcoal establish clarity, while soft grey creates premium separation between sections. No alternate palette is introduced.

layout.heroReason: The product benefits from a visual product demo shell, so a split hero gives room for a structured prompt-to-output interface mockup beside persuasive copy. This also satisfies the need for a fresh hero direction distinct from centered and full-bleed layouts.
layout.featureReason: Alternating sections let image-generation and video-generation capabilities feel like two distinct product lanes, which creates stronger contrast and avoids repeating the previously used tabbed, accordion, or split-panel feature patterns.
layout.darkSectionFor: Seedance 1.5 Pro video generation section, using charcoal panels with orange highlights to dramatize motion, synchronization, and cinematic control.

personality.imageryDirection: Use a premium dashboard-style product composition rather than a generic AI poster. The hero visual should show layered UI cards: prompt input, reference thumbnails, output preview frames, timing controls, and performance chips. For Seedream 4.5, show a high-fidelity image canvas with composition rails and typography-safe overlays. For Seedance 1.5 Pro, show a cinematic timeline, waveform strip, frame sequence, and synchronized audio-visual preview. Use subtle orange glows, crisp shadows, and translucent panels over white and charcoal surfaces. Avoid purple gradients and avoid overly abstract sci-fi spheres.
personality.designPersonality: Premium creative workstation meets enterprise software dashboard: structured, fast, polished, and highly usable. The page should feel like a professional AI production console built for creative teams who care about output quality, speed, and control.

designIntent.audience: Professionals creating visual content, including creative directors, video producers, art directors, marketing managers, and creative leads
designIntent.primaryUserIntent: Evaluate ByteDance generative AI capabilities for professional image and video production, then request a demo or quote after understanding use cases and quality potential

brandDirection.tone: Expert, credible, and performance-led with a B2B decision-making focus
brandDirection.visualStyle: Enterprise-oriented, content-first, vertically stacked modules with restrained UI, strong hierarchy, and minimal decorative treatment

sectionPurpose.purpose: Establish the combined product value proposition immediately and drive first-click conversion with one primary CTA
Reinforce AI capability breadth and enterprise-readiness early using concise badges
Explain the image-generation product value, quality, and editing capabilities for creative evaluation
Explain the video-generation product value, including audio-visual sync and production speed
Reduce purchase anxiety by showing role-relevant social proof from creative and marketing stakeholders

componentNeeds.variantHint: Single-screen, conversion-first hero with strong headline, supporting line, compact trust badges, and one dominant solid CTA
componentNeeds.notes: Keep the first screen decisive and uncluttered. If no product screenshot is available, use a centered or text-led hero with a strong brand-color background. Avoid competing CTAs.
Use compact enterprise and capability badges to quickly signal scope: image generation, video with audio, multimodal creation, enterprise infrastructure.

componentNeeds.variantHint: Two-column detail block with feature cards
componentNeeds.notes: Present Seedream as the image-generation anchor product. Use clean cards for the five benefits and keep CTA as request/demo-style action.

componentNeeds.variantHint: Two-column detail block with feature cards
componentNeeds.notes: Present Seedance as the adjacent video-generation capability. Emphasize audio-visual synchronization and production performance. CTA should remain clear but secondary to the hero.
Use quotes from creative director, video producer, art director, marketing manager, and creative lead to match the audience. Keep cards structured and credible.

layoutStrategy.hero: Lead with a strong split or centered hero depending on asset availability, using a dark or high-contrast brand-led background, white text, compact trust signals, and one clear primary conversion button.
layoutStrategy.features: Use vertically stacked product modules with strong section headers and 5-feature card grids. Seedream should read as the primary capability and Seedance as the complementary second capability. Maintain a clean, enterprise UI with light borders and generous spacing.
layoutStrategy.proof: Place trust badges immediately below the hero, followed by testimonial cards after the product explanation. Social proof should feel role-specific and decision-supportive rather than promotional.
layoutStrategy.pricing: Omit pricing as a primary module in the page flow unless business requirements explicitly add it later. If introduced later, treat it as a conversion card rather than a broad pricing table.
layoutStrategy.form: No form section is present in the input, so do not plan a lead form block. Primary conversion should route through the hero CTA and product-section CTAs.

designIntent.tokenProfileHint: Use a professional, technical, marketing-friendly default system: strong accent-led CTA treatment, dark or high-contrast hero treatment, clean neutral surfaces for feature cards, and restrained enterprise spacing. Prioritize clarity, hierarchy, and trust over visual experimentation.
designIntent.figmaReadySummary: This page should be planned as a long-form, category-style conversion landing page for creative professionals. The hero must communicate both Seedream 4.5 and Seedance 1.5 Pro in one clear promise, supported by immediate trust badges. Then structure two sequential product modules: first the image-generation product, then the video-generation product. Close with testimonial proof from relevant creative roles. Keep the visual language enterprise-clean, content-first, and conversion-focused, with minimal motion and no unnecessary layout branching.

figmaBuildPlan.tokenProfileHint: default + marketing typography, enterprise utility layout, restrained B2B trust styling, light grey separators, primary accent-led CTA system

sections.notes: Use a strong brand-colour hero background with white text. Since no explicit media asset is provided, keep the hero text-led with a compact benefit/badge cluster under the copy. Primary CTA should be the dominant action. Secondary CTA remains omitted because contentMap has no value.

Render badge pills in a centered horizontal row with subtle dividers and light grey section background. Use the four provided badges only. Do not invent customer count or social proof metrics because they are empty in source data.

Lead with the section label and headline, followed by the description and one focused CTA. Feature content should be shown in a 5-card grid using white utility cards with 1px borders. Keep icon areas available even though hasIcon is false; use text-only or simple SVG treatment if needed, but do not invent imagery.

Present as a second stacked product module with distinct label treatment for additional feature content. Use the same enterprise card system for visual consistency. Since CTA is empty in source, omit the button rather than substituting one.

Although pricing is optional in the reference, the input explicitly includes pricing plans, so render them. Use two side-by-side cards. Plan 1 has no price values, so present it as a quote-led card with the included checklist and CTA. Plan 2 includes the monthly starting price and should emphasize that value. Keep pricing cards clean and comparison-friendly.

Use a 3-column card grid on desktop, mapping five testimonials into two rows. Each card must include gold stars, italic quote text, bold author name, and grey designation. Keep card styling aligned to the design memory with a left accent border.

Stack hero content vertically. Because no media is provided, keep the mobile hero text-first with the CTA directly below supporting copy. Badge chips should wrap into multiple rows if necessary. Maintain high contrast and avoid adding extra actions.
Convert the badge row into a stacked, wrap-friendly chip cluster. Keep the section compact, with clear spacing between chips and no invented metrics.

Use a single-column stack with the intro copy first, then five feature cards in a vertical list. Preserve the same content hierarchy as desktop, but ensure cards are tall enough for the descriptions. Keep CTA visible above the feature stack if possible.
Stack the Seedance section below Seedream with consistent spacing and typography. Show its five capability cards in a single column. No CTA should be added because the source CTA is empty.

Render pricing cards full-width and stacked. The plan with explicit price should visually emphasize the starting price. Keep checklist content readable and maintain the quote/request-demo style of CTA. On mobile, remove heavy elevation and prioritize legibility.

Use a single-column stack with vertically separated testimonial cards. If needed, make the section horizontally scrollable only at the card level, but the default arrangement should be stacked to keep the page linear and readable.

figmaExecutionNotes: Use one design system token set across both pages; do not create separate visual styles for Seedream and Seedance beyond section labels and content.
Keep hero text-led because no media asset is provided; do not fabricate screenshots or product imagery.
Treat trust badges as a compact enterprise signal row, not a full social-proof module, because customer count and brand logos are absent.
Preserve the exact feature counts from source: 5 cards for Seedream and 5 cards for Seedance.
Pricing is included because it exists in contentMap even though the reference says it is optional; render it as a quote-oriented decision section, not a discount-heavy sales block.
Maintain linear scroll order: hero, trust, product section 1, product section 2, pricing, testimonials.
Mobile behavior should strictly follow stacking rules: single-column features, full-width pricing cards, and stacked testimonials.

End with a floating lead-capture card that feels like a conversion checkpoint. Keep the form concise, high-contrast, and friction-light, with one primary CTA and a clean enterprise panel treatment.
Optional footer-adjacent strip for media or partner logos if needed. If no logos are available, keep this section omitted in implementation.
